items.title: V7 cuts costs 78% while boosting accuracy with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.content: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.
items.contentSnippet: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.
items.summary: V7宣布基于GPT-5.6 Luna模型实现成本降低78%的同时提升准确率，该产品可将企业分散的文件转化为结构化上下文，供Agent完成复杂的溯源工作。属于AI Agent应用层的实践案例。
items.ai_reason: 涉及AI Agent将文件转换为上下文的实际应用场景，属于核心关注领域，但为产品新闻发布，缺少深度技术细节，基础分6分加Agent相关1分。
